answer.rationale: The incumbent will not reopen price and the mandated 18% spend reduction makes renewal unlikely to meet the cost objective. The prior low-cost vendor switch reportedly achieved sharp unit-cost reduction with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing, but its archived record should be verified because the current 94% line utilization and 14-day expiry make any delivery or transition failure materially consequential. A second-source action would not resolve the expiring primary contract or the immediate cost mandate.
